text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...What an incredible roar. Everyone's 
looking this way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Rice is watching too. Watching 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I can see everyone's happy faces 
clearly...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's because everyone was there for me 
that Rice was able to do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so... so very much...!

On that day, as the "star of the show," 
she delivered the finest race that brought 
smiles to everyone's faces—
